name: Mystral Lake
summary: Mystral Lake is the largest body of water in Ashenvale, resting in the south-central forest just below Silverwind Refuge. Its deep waters draw travelers from both the Alliance and the Horde.

sections.title: The Forest's Great Lake
sections.body: Spanning a vast expanse south of Silverwind Refuge and east of Talondeep Vale, Mystral Lake is the largest lake in Ashenvale. The night elves keep watch over it from their outpost at Silverwind Refuge on its northern shore, and travelers from both the Horde and the Alliance frequently find their journeys pulling them to its banks.

sections.title: Spiritual Crossroads
sections.body: Mystral Lake draws attention across faction lines. Horde shaman traveling the path of elemental communion seek out its deep waters during their trials to understand the element of water. The raw primal resonance of the lake makes it an essential pilgrimage site for those learning to bind and respect the tidal spirits.

faq.answer: Mystral Lake lies in south-central Ashenvale. It sits directly south of Silverwind Refuge and east of Talondeep Vale, making it the largest open body of water in the forest.

faq.q: Why do shaman visit Mystral Lake?
faq.answer: Horde shaman are directed to Mystral Lake during their spiritual trials for the Call of Water. The lake possesses a deep elemental resonance, making it an important location for understanding and attuning to water spirits.

aliases: is mystral lake horde or alliance
faq.answer: Neither faction holds direct military control over the lake itself. The night elves monitor it from their outpost at Silverwind Refuge on its northern shore.

angles.text: The turbulent depths of Mystral Lake serve as a vital stop during the Call of Water, where aspiring shaman must confront the local spirits to master their elemental craft.
Watched over from Silverwind Refuge, the largest lake in Ashenvale lies at the heart of the forest your people defend.
